2096. Converting Total Seconds into Hours, Minutes and Seconds

90

Hard

Problem Statement
Read a total number of seconds and print the equivalent duration in hours, minutes and seconds, using the % and / operators to break it down.

Description
Read an integer totalSeconds representing a duration in seconds. Extract the number of complete hours it contains using the / operator, then find the remaining seconds after removing those hours using the % operator. From the remaining seconds, extract the number of complete minutes using / and the leftover seconds using %. Print the hours, minutes and seconds, each on its own line. No loop or condition is needed since the breakdown is done with a fixed sequence of arithmetic steps.
output_spec: Print the number of hours, then minutes, then seconds, each on its own line.
